entries.text: SQLite SQL translation now targets the installed SQLite version, fails instead of emitting wrong dates for month-end interval arithmetic on SQLite older than 3.46 (strict and non-strict), and records the targeted SQLite version in translation outcomes.

The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.33.0.1 to 30.35.0.3 (fork commit `a27947de80cd`, upstream v30.35.0), a verified delivery of the benchbox-sqlglot fork. SQLite month, quarter and year offsets now use the `floor` modifier on SQLite 3.46 or later; on older engines only offsets from a DATE literal with day 28 or less translate, and other offsets fail translation.
